packages_rehearsed.title: 手征几何、隧穿与有限核态
packages_rehearsed.acceptance_enforcement: Antiunitary C = T Ry(pi), C^2 = +1; no phase-invariant chiral +/- label due to rephasing lambda' = e^(-2iphi)*lambda; finite tunneling barrier restores symmetry into Delta I = 1 partner bands; identical parity only permits but does not guarantee strong coupling.

packages_rehearsed.reader_check: Why do near-degenerate partner bands with identical I^pi not alone prove chirality, and why can antiunitary C not define a gauge-invariant +/- parity label?

packages_rehearsed.title: 由寿命、分支与内转换到绝对电磁强度
packages_rehearsed.acceptance_enforcement: Strictly distinguished mean lifetime tau and half-life T_1/2, energy width Gamma and decay rate lambda in s^-1, total branching b (including conversion) and relative photon intensity a; delta explicitly defined as photon emission amplitude ratio; B(sigma L) = partial photon rate / (C_sigma L * E^(2L+1)) with dimensional coefficient; no spurious hbar or ln2; same-parent lifetime cancellation vs cross-parent stopping-power covariance.
packages_rehearsed.strongest_rival: Pure multipole and zero-conversion approximation assigning all decay lifetimes directly to B(E2) with uncorrected shape interpretations
packages_rehearsed.reader_check: Why must rate not be written as ln 2 / tau given mean lifetime tau, and how does mistaking relative photon intensity a_i for total branching b_i bias extracted B(E2) when alpha is non-negligible?
packages_rehearsed.genuine_missing_inputs: None for generic spectroscopy inverse algebra; array full-energy peak efficiency curves and stopping power tables for specific experimental setups pending but not blocking this foundation chapter.
